label: Heavy industry
description: Coal and metal mining, steel and other metals, machinery, ships, railway equipment, tanks and munitions, and construction.

label: Energy
description: Oil and gas extraction, refining, and electric and gas utilities. Coal mining sits in heavy industry.

label: Consumer goods
description: Food processing, textiles and clothing, lumber and furniture, paper and printing, cars and household goods.

label: Technology and R&D
description: Chemicals and drugs, electrical equipment and electronics, aircraft, instruments, telephones and research laboratories.

label: Services and finance
description: Housing, banking, insurance, medicine, law, private education, entertainment and personal services. Cannot be imported.

label: Shipping and trade
description: Railways, trucking, shipping, airlines, warehouses, and wholesale and retail trade.
